summary: A calmer capybara that reacts when deadlines change, a new overdue look, and the 0.3.2 fixes for reminders and school blocks.
highlights: Animations are calmer: 5 frames a second instead of 10.
Your mascot reacts when things change: a hop when a deadline gets closer, a wiggle when you hand work in.
Overdue now looks slumped and defeated instead of asleep.
Reminders with long assignment names show the Snooze and Open buttons, and the bubble floats above the Dock.
When your school blocks Classroom, Mascot links a page you can send to your school's IT.
Uses less battery while idle, and works with the Dock on the left or right side of the screen.
Mascot Studio is put away for now, while the pack tools are finished.
